li.label: slaving in the fields
li.description: Dawn to dusk, bent over in the dirt. I'm a person, not a plow.

li.label: harvest push
li.description: Everyone in the fields, all day. My back has opinions.

li.label: good growing days
li.description: The whole colony working the land. That's how it should be.

li.label: a great harvest
li.description: Sun, soil and everyone pitching in.

li.label: hauling stone all day
li.description: Rock, mortar, more rock. I came here to live, not to build pyramids.

li.label: building season
li.description: Everyone on construction. Dust in everything.

li.label: raising walls
li.description: Watching the colony grow around us. Satisfying.

li.label: building something great
li.description: Every day the place gets bigger and better. I love it.

li.label: forced politeness
li.description: Smile, nod, say thank you. Every day. I'm going to explode.

li.label: best behavior
li.description: Minding my manners all day long. It's tiring.

li.label: a civil colony
li.description: Everyone's being kind to each other. It's pleasant.

li.label: warmth all round
li.description: The whole colony has become a friendlier place.

li.label: wasted mourning days
li.description: Everyone sitting around crying while the work piles up.

li.label: idle mourning
li.description: I respect the dead. I'd respect them better while working.

li.label: days of mourning
li.description: The colony stopped to remember. That matters.

li.label: grieving together
li.description: I'm not alone with this. Everyone stopped, for us.

li.label: constant alarm
li.description: Every shadow is a raider. Every noise is an attack. I can't breathe.

li.label: on guard
li.description: Weapons by the bed, sleeping in shifts. Exhausting.

li.label: ready for anything
li.description: Let them come. We're ready.

li.label: itching for a fight
li.description: Everyone's sharp, armed and waiting. Wonderful.

li.label: endless scrubbing
li.description: My hands are raw. The floor was fine. It was always fine.

li.label: clean sweep
li.description: Mops, buckets and more mops.

li.label: a clean colony
li.description: Everything gleams. Fewer sick people, too.

li.label: spotless
li.description: Finally, a colony as clean as it should be.

li.label: given a seat on the council
li.description: They chose me. Me! I'd better not make them regret it.

li.label: lost my seat
li.description: I had a seat on the council. Now someone else has it.

li.label: lost the vote to them
li.description: I should have had that seat. Everyone knows it. Apparently not everyone.
